entries.en: §LTiyanki are peaceful Space Fauna, capable of travelling along hyperlanes to find gas giants to graze upon.§!

entries.zh: §H$concept_astral_rifts$§!是一种异常的时空裂缝，会从中泄露维度间物质。在研究了£physics£§H$tech_rift_sphere$§!科技后可以用有科学官指挥的£science_ship£['concept_science_ships']进行探索。
entries.en: §H$concept_astral_rifts$§! are extraordinary tears in time and space that leak material between dimensions. They can be explored by crewed £science_ship£ ['concept_science_ships'] after researching the £physics£ §H$tech_rift_sphere$§! technology.

entries.zh: 在我们母星的远古撞击坑极深处探测到了异常的地震活动。地下声呐发现了一座前所未知的洞穴。
entries.en: Anomalous seismic activity has been detected from deep inside an ancient crater on our homeworld. Underground sonar revealed a previously unknown cavity that can be explored.

entries.zh: 这些蛮勇的领袖以迎接一场宇宙风暴般度过一生！他们勇敢无畏，不过在担任内阁职位时能力却略显不足。
entries.en: These daredevil leaders live their lives one cosmic storm at a time! Audacious and bold, they enjoy a shorter lifespan and become less effective when put in Council Positions.

entries.en: The flaws of evolution have plagued us for too long. We must reshape ourselves and unlock our full genetic potential.
